title: Exact Classic MajorMUD tick source
hypothesis: Tick/timing behavior is host-driven by MajorBBS/Worldgroup mechanisms such as TICKER, RTKICK, STSROU, SYSCYC, BEGIN_POLLING rather than client-side simulation or modem ping itself.
evidence_needed: MajorMUD module routine names mapped to host callback types
Runtime trace of repeated regen/spawn/combat updates
Confirmation of whether Classic uses TICKER comparisons or RTKICK/STSROU callbacks
promotion_requirements: At least one MajorMUD-specific execution trace or source routine mapping
Ordering relative to input and output established

title: Output flush boundary after module state mutation
hypothesis: Player sees updates when host/session flushes output after module processing; modem latency affects delivery but not authoritative state changes.
promotion_requirements: Trace showing state mutation before output delivery

title: Subsystem to callback mapping
hypothesis: Different subsystems may use different host callbacks rather than a single universal gameplay tick.
promotion_requirements: Per-subsystem callback evidence and deterministic probe confirmation
